name: site2md
solution: One `build --extract` step converts the page, runs a minimal Extractor written for this benchmark on the saved Markdown, and writes only the record values. The crawl runs the same step in site mode with `--max-pages 20 --max-depth 2` and reuses the same Extractor across the document's source sections. The step runs in the opt-in fast modes `--no-progress`, `--entry-points-only` and `--values-only`. site2md is installed from its release tag, because the PyPI name belongs to a different project. This is the Python package: the table also lists site2md's executable, and the chart shows the executable instead.
